# AudioBusParent <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Audio](BlitzBasic-Audio)

</div>


```blitzbasic
AudioBusParent:Void bus:Int32, parent:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `bus` | In | Int32 | required | A bus from [CreateAudioBus](CreateAudioBus). The master bus feeds nothing, so `0` is a runtime error. |
| `parent` | In | Int32 | required | The bus to feed, `0` for the master bus. A bus that would feed itself, through any number of buses, is a runtime error. |

## Description

<img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14"> This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

Makes a bus feed another bus. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

## Differences

* [GetAudioBusParent](GetAudioBusParent) tells the bus that one feeds.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
; Entering the cave: the cave sounds go through the world bus, so the pause menu turns them down too.
AudioBusParent cave, world
```
